Decomposed the ETA-411 description into 7 requirements REQ-ETA-411-001 to -007, every one EXTRACTED_FROM_JIRA with verbatim originalText and none authored. The description is two sentences of ADF prose with no Acceptance Criteria section, so acceptanceCriteria is deliberately left empty for AC_ANALYSIS to populate. The two Jira comments were read and deliberately excluded: both are Nitin Saini progress notes about the delivery of this POC automation framework itself, not statements about eCore behaviour, and treating them as requirements would make the framework a requirement on the product it tests. Six ambiguities raised, all REVIEW_REQUIRED, covering the Closed status and story ownership, the missing role to module authorization mapping, the identity of the supporting APIs given that eCore exposes no REST resource model, the undefined observable outcome of preventing unauthenticated or unauthorized access, the undefined meaning of consistent module access, and the Dashboard versus Home page naming. Four of the six block acceptance criteria outright. validate:requirements passed 5 of 5.

Jira description revised again and both stages re-run against it. The entire change is nine characters: authorized for my organization and role became authorized for my organization. The role dimension is gone; the second sentence about supporting APIs and preventing unauthenticated or unauthorized access is unchanged. Re-promoted requirements/raw/ETA-411.json from the fresh snapshot and rewrote requirements/normalized/ETA-411.json: story.description, REQ-ETA-411-001 description and originalText, and AMB-ETA-411-002 which now asks for an organization to module mapping instead of a role to module mapping. REQ-002 to REQ-007 and the other five ambiguities are unaffected. AMB-ETA-411-002 is deliberately NOT marked RESOLVED: the revision narrowed the question from role-based to organization-based authorization but did not answer it, and only a human may resolve an ambiguity. artifactVersion stays 1 because nothing here was ever approved, so this is a revised draft rather than a new version of published content.
